modules.name: Project Delivery & Coordination
modules.description: Coordinate delivery against the three-month target and tight budget, with clear scope, decisions, and cross-role communication.

tasks.title: Project management and communication
tasks.description: Plan and track delivery, coordinate design and engineering, manage dependencies and risks, and communicate progress and decisions with the client.
tasks.rationale: Cross-cutting coordination is needed to deliver the requested scope within the target timeline and budget.

modules.name: Product Design
modules.description: Create high-fidelity mockups and reusable component styles for the web application.

tasks.title: High-fidelity mockups and component styles
tasks.description: Design responsive page mockups and a reusable component style system covering the dashboard, search, public pages, authentication, and admin workflows; review designs with stakeholders.
tasks.rationale: Design deliverables are explicitly requested and provide implementation guidance across the application.

modules.name: Platform Foundation
modules.description: Establish the application environments, delivery pipeline, and baseline quality practices.

tasks.title: Application environments and CI/CD
tasks.description: Set up the application environments and automated build, test, and deployment pipeline using proven technology appropriate to the agreed web stack.
tasks.rationale: A deployable foundation and repeatable releases are necessary for a web application with a short delivery target.

tasks.title: QA and regression testing
tasks.description: Define and execute a risk-based test plan covering core user journeys, integrations, responsive behavior, and regression checks; report and verify defects.
tasks.rationale: Testing across billing, authentication, admin, and public experiences is essential to reduce launch risk.

tasks.title: Code review and quality checks
tasks.description: Review implementation changes for correctness, maintainability, security-sensitive issues, and consistency with agreed conventions; provide actionable feedback.
tasks.rationale: Code review is a required hidden delivery activity that helps maintain quality while using proven technology.

modules.name: Public Web Experience
modules.description: Implement responsive public pages and the dashboard and search experiences.

tasks.title: Responsive public pages and SEO basics
tasks.description: Implement public-facing pages with responsive layouts and foundational SEO support, including appropriate page metadata and semantic structure.
tasks.rationale: Public pages and responsive layouts are explicitly required; SEO basics are part of the requested public experience.

tasks.title: Dashboard widgets, filters, and empty states
tasks.description: Implement the main dashboard interface with widgets, filter controls, and useful empty states, using the approved designs.
tasks.rationale: The dashboard is a distinct user-facing feature with several explicitly requested interaction states.

tasks.title: Search results, filters, sorting, and pagination
tasks.description: Implement the search results page interface, including filter controls, sorting, pagination, and relevant loading or empty states.
tasks.rationale: Search has a distinct set of controls and states that should be implemented and tested as a feature.

tasks.title: Dashboard and search data APIs
tasks.description: Implement backend endpoints and query behavior needed to supply dashboard widgets and filtered, sorted, paginated search results, based on the agreed data model.
tasks.rationale: The requested dashboard and search controls require backend data and query support; exact data sources and search semantics need confirmation.

modules.name: Authentication & Enterprise SSO
modules.description: Provide account access flows and integrate the client's identity provider for enterprise login.

tasks.title: Registration, login, reset, and verification services
tasks.description: Implement account registration and login, password reset, and email verification flows, including the required backend endpoints and account state handling.
tasks.rationale: These account lifecycle capabilities are explicitly required and need backend support.

tasks.title: Authentication user interfaces
tasks.description: Implement responsive registration, login, password reset, and email verification screens and their user-facing states.
tasks.rationale: Backend account flows need corresponding user interfaces to be usable.

tasks.title: Enterprise identity provider SSO integration
tasks.description: Integrate login with the client's identity provider using the agreed protocol and configuration; handle sign-in outcomes and coordinate access and configuration validation with the client.
tasks.rationale: SSO depends on an external identity provider and client-provided access and configuration; protocol and provider details are not specified.

modules.name: Catalog & Content Administration
modules.description: Allow administrators to manage products or items and maintain editable site content.

tasks.title: Product and item administration services
tasks.description: Implement admin backend operations for creating, viewing, editing, and deleting products or items, including category and image associations.
tasks.rationale: Admin CRUD and associated category and image data require backend operations and persistence.

tasks.title: Product and item administration interface
tasks.description: Implement admin screens for product or item CRUD, category management, and image selection or upload, using the approved designs.
tasks.rationale: Administrators need a user interface to use the requested catalog management capabilities.

tasks.title: Static page, FAQ, and banner editing services
tasks.description: Implement backend operations to create, view, edit, and delete static pages, FAQs, and banners, including persistence and the data needed to render published content.
tasks.rationale: Editable content requires backend management and a way for public pages to retrieve the resulting content.

tasks.title: Static page, FAQ, and banner editor
tasks.description: Implement admin interfaces for editing static pages, FAQs, and banners, including appropriate forms and preview or status states where supported by the agreed scope.
tasks.rationale: The requested content editing capability requires an admin-facing interface; preview and publishing details should be confirmed.

modules.name: Billing & Payments
modules.description: Support recurring billing, invoice generation, Stripe card payments, refunds, and payment webhooks.

tasks.title: Recurring billing and PDF invoice generation
tasks.description: Implement recurring billing plan and subscription handling through Stripe and generate PDF invoices for applicable billing events; confirm invoice content and lifecycle expectations with the client.
tasks.rationale: Recurring billing and PDF invoices are explicitly required; invoice details and subscription rules are not specified.

tasks.title: Stripe card payments, refunds, and webhooks
tasks.description: Integrate Stripe card payment processing, support refunds, and implement secure webhook handling for relevant payment and billing events, including verification and idempotent processing.
tasks.rationale: Stripe is the assumed provider, and payment, refund, and webhook handling are explicit requirements.

tasks.title: Billing and payment user interface
tasks.description: Implement the user-facing payment and billing screens needed to select or manage plans and complete card payments, aligned with the agreed billing flows.
tasks.rationale: Payment and recurring billing capabilities require user-facing flows; exact plan management and checkout scope should be confirmed.
